meta.title: Prompt Optimizer
meta.description: One button in the composer rewrites what you typed into a clearer prompt and puts it back into the input box.

button.tip: Rewrite the current draft as a structured prompt (does not send)
button.tipDone: Filled back into the composer; keep editing before you send
button.empty: The composer is empty — write a line first.
button.tooLong: Draft is longer than 6000 characters; trim it first.
button.noRoute: This session has no model route yet.
